# smart-immunizations-web-annexes

The annex files themselves, as smart-base's `web-annex` kind (a WHO publication's web annexes, L1 or L2), typed and judged by `check:web-annexes`. `dak-data-dictionary.json` is Web Annex A of the IMMZ DAK (`annexOf` `who-iris/library/9789240099456-eng`, IRIS 10665/380303; `section` `dak#core-data-elements`; no `iris` of its own, since none could be verified): the core data dictionary workbook (`input/L2/IMMZ DAK_core data dictionary.xlsx`) as `dak-data-dictionary/v1`, written by smart-base's `dak-data-dictionary.ts` (`--annex-of who-iris/library/9789240099456-eng --label "Web Annex A" --section dak#core-data-elements`). It records the workbook's sha256: regenerate it, never edit it. It sits beside `annexes/`, not inside it: each kind owns the `$schema` families of its own directory, and a declared directory inside another declared one fails `check:layout-norms`.

Part of [WHO SMART Guidelines — Immunizations](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `smart-immunizations-web-annexes`, holding `web-annex`.

| file | what it is | used by |
